title: Britain Skipped Eleven Days, But The Riot Is A Myth
description:
In September 1752 Britain's calendar skipped eleven days (the change was made so that nobody would gain or lose by it). Many history books report riots with people demanding 'give us our eleven days', but this is very likely a myth: it rests on just two sources, a satirical journal and a painting by William Hogarth, and there are no contemporary records of such riots in the riot depositions at the Public Record Office.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Calendar (New Style) Act 1750'.

What popular history story is secretly false? Tell us in the comments.
